DEF-06.quality_flags: Retained; no flag-based exclusion or parameter selection.

DEF-07.drawdown: All UTC acquisitions before index.gap.start, fixed before evaluation.
DEF-07.first_detection: First drawdown acquisition with area strictly below the boundary.

DEF-11.high_rule: area >= mean - 2 * sample SD; no numerical storage estimate
DEF-11.high_lower_pct: Minimum actual storage among all observations classified high.
DEF-11.calibration: Last in-band drawdown observation plus all out-of-band drawdown observations with official storage. Points are sorted by area, not by storage.
DEF-11.numeric_rule: Piecewise linear interpolation. Below the minimum area, extrapolate the lowest two area points. Clamp storage to [0,100], preserve raw values and flags.
DEF-11.duplicate_calibration_areas: Reject ambiguous calibration; do not average or fit away.
DEF-11.range: Estimate +/- reservoir-specific maximum DEF-12 low-water leave-one-out absolute error, clipped to [0,100]. Descriptive error envelope, not a confidence interval or future guarantee. The area threshold-sensitivity bars are a separate quantity.
DEF-11.grade_gate: Only published grade A is eligible; B and C have no estimates.

DEF-12.high: Report count and minimum actual storage. Compare predicted high/numeric with actual storage >= that descriptive minimum, reporting both confusion directions. The reference minimum comes from the high group itself: false-high count is therefore zero by construction for observed pairs, not independent accuracy.
DEF-12.numeric: Leave each out-of-band drawdown observation out of the interpolation calibration, keeping the fixed full-pool boundary and in-band anchor. Score the clamped estimate; report each absolute error, MAE and maximum absolute error separately from categorical results. Later out-of-band observations are not low-water folds.
DEF-12.gate: Completeness and finite-result checks only. DEF-12 provides no numerical accuracy acceptance threshold. No threshold was invented or tuned.
limitations: Full-year official observations define the band and descriptive lower bound.
Classifier choices used this archive; this remains exploratory calibration.
Only one drawdown; adjacent leave-one-out observations are correlated.
No second drawdown or independent future event has been evaluated.

DEF-05.calibration_mean: For each numeric fold, mean storage of its remaining calibration.
DEF-05.archive_mean: Descriptive all-date mean; in-sample, not a forecast baseline.
DEF-05.previous_official: Previous chronological acquisition's official storage only when Taiwan calendar dates are exactly 12 days apart. Missing previous readings and all longer gaps are excluded, with reasons retained. Report all eligible and numeric-fold cohorts.

DEF-04-C1.method: First N valid pairs, ordinary least squares with intercept; no clipping.
DEF-04-C1.evaluation: All later valid pairs. Every N is reported, no best N is selected.

calibration_mean.cohort: Same low-water leave-one-out folds; remaining calibration mean.

archive_mean.cohort: All paired archive dates; descriptive in-sample mean.

previous_official.cohort: All consecutive acquisitions exactly 12 Taiwan calendar days apart.

previous_official_low_water.cohort: Numeric DEF-12 fold dates having an exactly 12-day predecessor.

reference_comparison.comparison_precision: 1 decimal pp; integer storage pct; exact counts and local dates
reference_comparison.previous_official_cohort_note: Strict 12-calendar-day pairs only (n=17). The advice's Liyutan 4.3 pp can be reproduced by including two 24-day intervals (n=19), excluded by this baseline.
